messages:
deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy window starting 2026-03-20 22:00 UTC for release v1.14.0. Components: runtime v2.3.1, router v1.8.0, api v4.2.0, console v0.9.7. Canary plan: 5% -> 20% -> 50% -> 100%. Runbook: https://runbook.internal/redwood/releases/v1.14.0

maria: Can we confirm ordering? I want runtime first to ensure kernel/quantization changes are active before router routing.

sam: agree. runtime -> router -> api -> console. Router needs new header for KV pinning, so router before api.

lee: Heads up: console feature flags need api v4.2.0 schema, so console must be last and blocked on API migrations.

anjali: Rollback criteria: >1% 5xx OR p95 latency increase > 150ms over baseline for 5 minutes. If triggered, rollback last component only and freeze traffic shift.

sam: Noted. Also adding a safety pin: keep runtime v2.2.9 available as fallback in the pool for 30m post-upgrade.

deploy-bot: Starting step 1: runtime rollout to canary pool (5%). Command: ```deployctl rollout runtime --version v2.3.1 --canary 5 --wait --health-threshold 99```

maria: I'm watching metrics. If canary looks good at +10m, we'll bump to 20%.

opsbot: Alert rule check passthrough - all hooks green for runtime canary at 5%.

lee: Router rollout should include header compat shim. Router image tag: router@sha256:abcd1234. Deploy sequence note: apply router config -> warm caches -> shift traffic 10%.

sam: I'll pin router config in config-repo to `router-config/prod#release-2145` before rolling.

maria: API migrations: running soft-migrate first. Note: don't flip migration flag until api at 50%.

anjali: If API shows schema error cascade on console unit tests in staging after 50% canary, hold and revert API only.

deploy-bot: Completed runtime 5% at 2145678920. Next: router 5% queued. Manual ack required: @maria @sam

maria: :thumbsup: acked. Proceed router 5%.

sam: Router 5% done. Observing small p95 bump +20ms, under threshold.

opsbot: Monitoring: 5xx at 0.12% during router canary, p95 +28ms. Within rollback thresholds.

maria: Bump router to 20%.

deploy-bot: Router 20% in progress. Reminder: if p95 > +150ms or 5xx > 1% for 5m, run: ```deployctl rollback router --to v1.7.6```

lee: Also note: if KV eviction increases, we'll immediately pin router to previous and throttle API.

anjali: Console deployment scheduled last. I'll prep feature flag toggles and JIRA link: https://jira/redwood/INF-2145

maria: If all clear at router 50% and api 20% canary OK, schedule console at +30m outside maintenance window (golden hour at 01:00 UTC).

sam: Agree. I'll create a brief release note for CS with exact change list.

deploy-bot: Final checklist: runtime fallback v2.2.9 registered, router config pinned, API migrations soft-run, console flags staged. Watchers: maria/sam/anjali/lee. End of thread.
